answer: The timber counter is kept in jetty and shale publishes each reset. An farming party therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 386 aliases cost 197 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
